comment: The standard downloads registry (tools/downloadArtifacts.js; WORKORDER-standardDownloads-101526). One row per forge bundle offered for download. family is NOT here: it is read from the graph (StandardDefinition.standardFamily) or, for a bundle the graph does not hold, from the bundle's own forge declaration. version likewise comes from the graph; versionText is used only for a bundle the graph does not hold. A graph standard with no row here is refused by name, never quietly left out.

licenceHoldList.rulingText: IVORY_QUEST 2026-10-15, approving CORAL_BEACON's proposal: both Ed-Fi entries unavailable until TQ rules otherwise

licenceHoldList.unavailableReason: Withheld under the 1EdTech Specification Document License (https://www.imsglobal.org/license.html): its §4 licenses using the Specification to develop and distribute PRODUCTS that implement it, and §5 grants no right to create modifications or derivatives of 1EdTech documents, so neither the specification's bytes nor a graph derived from them is redistributed here. The round trip was still run against this graph; its totals are shown.
